name: Mexic-Arte Museum
hours_summary: Mon–Thu · 10 AM – 6 PM · Fri–Sat 10 AM – 5 PM · Sun noon – 5 PM
best_for: Fans of Mexican and Latino contemporary art
tagline: Austin's Mexican and Latino art museum, right on Congress Avenue.
description: A small but serious museum of Mexican, Latino, and Latin American contemporary art on Congress Avenue. Three gallery spaces rotate exhibitions by Mexican and Latinx artists; the annual Viva la Vida Festival and Parade around Día de los Muertos is the signature event.

tips.text: Visit around late October for the Viva la Vida parade and ofrendas on Congress Avenue.

highlights.item: Rotating contemporary Mexican and Latinx exhibitions
Front-window cart platform for emerging Latinx artists

distance_landmark: Downtown, 5 blocks south of Texas Capitol
